targets.rawSql: select now() as time, count(*) as value from codex_trace_sessions_dashboard where $__timeFilter(session_started_at) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$);

select now() as time, coalesce(round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by session_duration_ms))::numeric, 2), 0) as value from codex_trace_sessions_dashboard where $__timeFilter(session_started_at) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$);

select now() as time, coalesce(max(session_duration_ms), 0) as value from codex_trace_sessions_dashboard where $__timeFilter(session_started_at) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$);

select now() as time, coalesce(round(avg(log_event_count), 2), 0) as value from codex_trace_sessions_dashboard where $__timeFilter(session_started_at) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$);

select $__timeGroupAlias(session_started_at, '5m'), round(avg(session_duration_ms), 2) as avg_duration_ms, max(session_duration_ms) as max_duration_ms from codex_trace_sessions_dashboard where $__timeFilter(session_started_at) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$) group by 1 order by 1;

select trace_id, session_started_at, session_duration_ms, root_span_name, slowest_span_name, slowest_span_duration_ms, span_count, log_event_count, api_event_count, tool_event_count, user_id, team, conversation_id from codex_trace_sessions_dashboard where $__timeFilter(session_started_at) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$) order by session_duration_ms desc, session_started_at desc limit 50;

select s.event_time, s.trace_id, s.span_id, s.span_name, s.duration_ms, coalesce(t.user_id, s.user_id) as user_id, coalesce(t.team, s.team) as team, t.conversation_id, s.service_name, s.rpc_method, s.transport, s.tool_name from codex_trace_spans_dashboard s left join codex_trace_sessions_dashboard t on s.trace_id = t.trace_id where $__timeFilter(s.event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or coalesce(t.team, s.team) = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or coalesce(t.user_id, s.user_id) = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or t.conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or s.service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or s.trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$) order by s.duration_ms desc, s.event_time desc limit 100;

select event_time, trace_id, span_id, request_type, correlated_span_name, correlated_span_duration_ms, user_id, team, conversation_id, trace_service_name from codex_trace_log_correlation_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and event_source = 'api' and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$) order by event_time desc limit 100;

select event_time, trace_id, span_id, tool_name, tool_success, tool_duration_ms, correlated_span_name, correlated_span_duration_ms, user_id, team, conversation_id from codex_trace_log_correlation_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and event_source = 'tool' and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$) order by event_time desc limit 100;

select event_time, trace_id, span_id, event_kind, item_id, arguments_size, correlated_span_name, correlated_span_duration_ms, user_id, team, conversation_id from codex_trace_log_correlation_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and event_source = 'fn_call' and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$) order by event_time desc limit 100;

select event_time, trace_id, approval_type, approval_duration_ms, span_name, user_id, team, conversation_id, root_span_name, slowest_span_name from codex_trace_approval_spans_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${service_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or service_name = $v$${service_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${trace_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or trace_id = $v$${trace_id:text}$v$) order by event_time desc limit 100;
